item.text: I’m checking for direct evidence that Putin framed welfare as an end in itself versus using it as a propaganda, patronage, or war-support tool. I’ll rely mostly on primary Kremlin and major-reporting material, then stop once the claim set is saturated.

item.text:
**6B.1, 2024: mostly no**
Putin did make some real social-welfare moves, mainly for families, children, and disabled people. But the overall pattern was that welfare was secondary to war, propaganda, and loyalty-building, not the core purpose of rule.

| Stance | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Support | Officially sets development goals through 2030 and 2036, emphasizing economic sovereignty, population growth, fair competition, private initiative, and technological effectiveness | President of Russia | 2024-05-07 | https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/73986 | Putin’s formal agenda explicitly includes higher living standards and population growth. This is the strongest top-level welfare language, but it is aspirational rather than proof that welfare was treated as the overriding purpose of rule. | 6B.1, 5B.6, 5B.7 |
| Support | The government said the president had signed an order making equal support for families with three or more children available nationwide | Government of Russia | 2024-01-25 | https://government.ru/en/news/50700/ | A concrete nationwide family-support measure that reduced regional variation. This is real welfare policy, though narrow and heavily family-centered. | 6B.1, 5B.8 |
| Support | Government expanded rules support for citizens caring for disabled people | Government of Russia | 2024-02-08 | https://government.ru/news/50822/ | Parents and guardians caring for disabled children could keep the monthly allowance even if they worked part-time. This is a direct welfare measure for a vulnerable group. | 6B.1, 5B.8 |
| Support | Service “life situation” for large families launched on the public-services portal | Government of Russia | 2024-10-21 | https://government.ru/news/53064/ | The state simplified access to services for large families through one digital channel. That is useful administrative support, but still targeted and instrumental. | 6B.1, 5B.6, 5B.8 |
| Support | Russia expands pilot project for rehabilitation of children with disabilities | Government of Russia | 2024-12-09 | https://government.ru/docs/53649/ | The pilot project broadened access to rehabilitation services for disabled children across more regions. This is one of the clearest child-welfare measures in 2024. | 6B.1, 5B.6, 5B.8 |
| Against | Russia: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says the regime uses corruption, propaganda, and coercion to maintain control. The broader system treats public welfare as secondary to regime survival and patronage. | 6B.1, 5B.5, 5B.7 |
| Against | Russia: Nations in Transit 2024 Country Report | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2024 | Freedom House says the war remained the dominant issue and authorities tried to portray normality through elections and patriotic appeals. That supports the view that welfare was subordinated to propaganda and wartime legitimacy. | 6B.1, 5B.7, 5B.9 |
| Against | Russia’s economy shows solid growth despite Ukraine war sanctions | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-28 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-economy-shows-solid-growth-despite-ukraine-war-sanctions-3591756 | Reuters said growth and low unemployment were heavily driven by military production, not civilian welfare. That suggests war capacity, not human welfare, was the main economic priority. | 6B.1, 5B.6, 5B.9, 5B.10 |
| Against | Analysis: Russia braces for more tax rises to fund the Ukraine war | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-10-31 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/analysisrussia-braces-for-more-tax-rises-to-fund-the-ukraine-war-3693480 | War spending forced more taxes and squeezed other priorities. That points to extraction for war rather than welfare as the core objective. | 6B.1, 5B.6, 5B.9, 5B.10 |
| Against | Russia’s security state was highly effective at detaining Putin’s opponents but failed to stop the mass shooting | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-03-25 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/moscow-shooting-poses-awkward-questions-for-russias-intelligence-agencies-3352104 | Reuters’ framing suggests the state was optimized for repression, not civilian protection. That cuts against welfare as the primary purpose of rule. | 6B.1, 5B.9, 5B.7 |
| Against | Exclusive: Putin-controlled aircraft, deported Ukrainian children, US-backed research alleges | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-03 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/exclusiveputincontrolled-aircraft-deported-ukrainian-children-usbacked-research-alleges-3750835 | If accepted, this allegation indicates the state used resources to transfer and remold children from occupied territory, which is the opposite of treating human welfare as the core purpose. | 6B.1, 5B.8, 5B.9 |
| Against | UN says Russia continues torture, execute Ukrainian POWs | United Nations in Ukraine | 2024-03-26 | https://ukraine.un.org/en/264368-un-says-russia-continues-torture-execute-ukrainian-pows | The UN reported torture and sexual violence against POWs. That is strong evidence that human welfare was not the core purpose in wartime governance. | 6B.1, 5B.9 |
| Against | Ukraine human rights situation remains bleak three years after Russia’s full-scale armed aggression | United Nations in Ukraine | 2024-12-31 | https://ukraine.un.org/en/286771-ukraine-human-rights-situation-remains-bleak-three-years-after-russia%E2%80%99s-full-scale-armed | The UN said civilian casualties were rising and executions and torture continued in occupied territory. That is strong late-year evidence against welfare-first rule. | 6B.1, 5B.9 |

Bottom line: there is real but narrow welfare administration for families, children, and disabled people, yet the stronger 2024 evidence shows welfare subordinated to wartime mobilization, repression, and propaganda.

Search gap: I did not find convincing evidence that Putin treated broad human welfare as the central purpose of rule in 2024. The pro evidence is limited to targeted social support and aspirational rhetoric; the negative evidence is broader and more structural.
